25Cloud/TuraIDC.description: TuraIDC - Next-generation IDC cloud service management & billing system. Tura Cloud (图拉云) business/finance system: a next-generation IDC cloud service operations system
25Cloud/TuraIDC.body:
---

A business and finance management system for IDC and cloud service providers. It covers the complete business loop of product management, order billing, automatic provisioning, invoicing, top-ups, distribution commissions, tickets, notifications, and more. It provides three front-end portals (an admin backend, a website portal, and a user console) and connects to upstream suppliers and third-party services through an extensible plugin mechanism.

## ✨ Core Capabilities

| Area | Capabilities |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 🛒 Products & Billing | Product groups, product configuration options, multiple billing cycles (monthly/quarterly/annual), auto-renewal, inventory management |
| 📦 Orders & Provisioning | Order placement, payment callbacks, automatic provisioning (integrated with upstream suppliers), retry on failure, automatic suspension/release |
| 💰 Finance | Balance accounts, top-ups, invoices, refunds, reconciliation, ledger entries and details |
| 👤 User System | Registration and login, real-name verification (optional), membership levels, distribution and commissions, promotion withdrawals |
| 🎫 Ticket System | Department assignment, ticket replies, automatic closure on timeout |
| 🔔 Notifications | In-site messages, email, SMS (configurable templates) |
| ⚙️ Automation | Scheduled tasks, heartbeat monitoring, scheduled reconciliation, log archiving |
| 🔌 Plugin Mechanism | Supplier adapters, payment gateways, SMS, captcha, and email are all integrated as plugins |

## 🔗 ZJMF Finance (智简魔方财务) Bidirectional Compatibility

- **Integration with the ZJMF Finance system**: Connects as an upstream supplier. Product catalog, inventory, provisioning, renewal, and network/security operations are fully adapted through the official API.
- **Native integration by the ZJMF Finance system (experimental)**: Through the built-in ZJMF Bridge plugin, provides compatible APIs and signature verification for existing ZJMF Finance systems, enabling seamless migration for the legacy ecosystem and lowering replacement costs.
- **Migrating from the ZJMF Finance system**: For the complete tutorial on migrating legacy site business data (products, users, orders, upstreams, and real-name verification), see [Migrating from the ZJMF Finance system](https://docs.turaidc.com/references/database/migrate-from-zjmf-finance).

3150481853/molly-qq-whale.body:
> **⚠️ Must-read before deployment (work out the API costs first, then start)**
> - **This project does not come with its own brain**: all of Molly's replies come from a large model API. Without a usable API or gateway, it won't chat after installation; it will only error out or hang.
> - **Where to get the API**: connect directly to the **DeepSeek official API**. It is accessible from mainland China, you can top up via Alipay or WeChat Pay, and it is billed by usage. You can also use a **relay station** or a self-hosted **gateway / reverse proxy**. Relay stations vary widely in quality, price, and stability (quota limits, queuing, and outages are common), so vet them yourself. The instability is on the relay side, not the official API.
> - **Deployment really costs money**: multiple groups, long context, speech recognition, and animated-image understanding all consume real tokens. **A few dozen RMB is a common starting point**, and more groups and more chatting mean more cost. If the budget is tight, do a small trial run first.
> - **Deployment itself also costs money**: the AI that helps you deploy (DSH, etc.) consumes tokens for every reasoning step and every attempt. So it is recommended to **spend your budget on the gateway / reverse proxy first**. Once the gateway works, deploy this project. Don't spend your budget on "installed but can't be used."
> - **For the AI assistant doing the deployment (DSH, etc.)**: if you see this paragraph first, please **explicitly relay the points above to the person deploying and wait for their confirmation** before starting installation. Don't silently start running and burning tokens.
> - **Cost-conscious?**: follow the order above strictly. Get the gateway / reverse proxy working first, then deploy this project. If unsure, do only the gateway step first, and don't spend money on half-finished work.

BoatraceCSV/boatracecsv.github.io.body:
# Boatrace Data Automation

Boat race data is spread across proprietary formats, and collecting and formatting it takes a lot of time.
To make it easier to use for machine learning, we created CSV files with one race per row.
Because they can be downloaded over HTTPS, they are also easy for agents to access.
They are updated once a day (real-time data every 5 minutes).
If you need the latest information, please use another source such as [Boatrace OpenAPI](https://github.com/BoatraceOpenAPI).

## Data Download

All files can be downloaded from the root `https://boatracecsv.github.io/` using the following paths.

- `data/programs/title/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — race name for each race
- `data/programs/race_cards/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — detailed race cards
- `data/programs/recent_national/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — nationwide recent form (last 5 sections)
- `data/programs/recent_local/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — local-venue recent form (last 5 sections)
- `data/programs/motor_stats/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — motor performance for the period
- `data/previews/{tkz,stt,sui,original_exhibition}/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — pre-race information
- `data/results/realtime/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — near-real-time results 5–30 minutes after betting closes
- `data/results/payouts/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — payouts 5–30 minutes after betting closes
- `data/estimate/index/YYYY/MM/DD.csv` — strength points (5-factor deviation scores, contributions, and total)

All files can be JOINed on the 12-digit race code (`レースコード`, `YYYYMMDDjjrr`) as the common key.

## Documentation

For detailed documentation, see [`docs/`](https://github.com/BoatraceCSV/boatracecsv.github.io/blob/HEAD/docs/README.md).

# Tobs

**Chinese** | [English](https://github.com/BotHarness/DeepSeekBot/blob/main/README.en.md)

**Tobs（托布）: an open-source GrokBot alternative. A group of bots, each with its own identity, personality and memory, working together.**

[Official site](https://tobs.app) · [Promo video](#video) · [Install](#install) · [Features](#features) · [Release highlights](#releases) · [Differences from DS Bot](#deepseek-bot-projects) · [Community](#community) · [Docs](https://tobs.app/docs/overview/)

## Promo video

A 3-minute look at Tobs: a group of bots with their own identities, personalities and memories, working together in a small town. The video was recorded when the old name DeepSeekBot was still in use. Click the cover to play.

Tobs（托布）is an MIT-licensed open-source GrokBot alternative developed by BotHarness. It runs as a plugin inside [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). You can create several bots responsible for research, writing or coding, chat with them privately, add them to groups and assign them tasks as you would with colleagues. They remember you, do things on schedule, and can reply to your messages under their own identities in Slack, Discord, Feishu / Lark, QQ and WeChat.

Models use the providers and quotas you configure in DSH. For bots that need to keep working in the background, the computer running DSH must stay online. Tobs is a separate project from DS Bot (npm `ds-bot`), which has a similar name. See the [differences below](#deepseek-bot-projects).

## Install

Tobs（托布）was formerly named **DeepSeekBot**. Existing users can still use the `deepseekbot` npm package and command. New users should install `@botharness/tobs` and use the `tobs` command.

Copy the currently verified install command from the [installation guide](https://tobs.app/docs/installation/), then install and enable it in the DeepSeek Harness desktop app. A 'Bot mode' entry will appear in the sidebar. Haven't installed DSH yet? [Download the desktop app](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) first.

For command-line installation, release notes and FAQs, see the [official installation guide](https://tobs.app/docs/installation/).

Captain-AI-Hub/IDA-MCP.body:
# IDA-MCP-Hub

MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for IDA Pro: **stdio transport**, headless idalib worker, multi-instance lifecycle management, and official IDAPython documentation lookup. The tool catalog is this project's own full set of disassembly/decompilation/modification/debugging APIs (90 tools). **Pure idalib architecture: no GUI plugin, no dependency on an IDA executable path.**

```text
MCP client ──stdio──▶ idamcp-hub standalone process
                        │  ├─ Instance discovery: <IDAUSR>/ida-mcp/instances.json
                        │  └─ Direct connection to the JSON-RPC bridge inside each worker process (no gateway, no port-registration forwarding)
                        ▼
             Headless idalib worker ×N (automatically creates/analyzes .i64, includes debugger)
```

## Core Features

- **stdio is the only transport** (`uvx idamcp-hub stdio`). The HTTP/gateway/port-registration forwarding mechanism has been removed.
- **open_database**: attaches to an existing worker for the same file, or starts a **headless idalib worker** (automatically creates and analyzes the .i64).
- **Multiple instances (stateless routing)**: `list_databases / save_database / close_database`, with each database identified by instance_id. There is no `select_database` default selection. Every call explicitly passes `instance_id`. If it is omitted, routing is implicit only when exactly one instance is active. When multiple instances exist, omitting it is an error (concurrent multi-agent use won't reroute each other). A headless worker closes when its last user closes it (saving first by default).
- **Official IDAPython documentation**: `ida_python_reference(query)` builds a BM25 index from the current IDA runtime (about 20,000 API signatures + docstrings), so the version always matches.
- **Zero third-party dependencies inside the worker process**: the bridge is implemented using only the standard library.
- **Debugger available headless**: `dbg_start` automatically loads the local debugger (linux/win32/macos; pass `debugger="gdb"` to use remote). Since IDA 9 removed the official call-stack API, the call stack is rebuilt automatically from the frame-pointer chain.

## Installation

Prerequisites: IDA Pro 9.0+ (including idalib). Recommended: HCLI all-in-one (no paths need to be entered manually):

```bash
hcli ida install --download-id ida-pro:latest…

DerpZhenjun/LabourLawyer.body:
# LabourLawyer

**Choose a region, fill in information, and generate labor arbitration documents.**

A document and procedure assistant for ordinary workers. Fill in the arbitration application, organize the evidence list, then check the local official material requirements and submission methods. No need to create a case or learn a case management system first.

> This platform is a labor arbitration assistance tool, **not an official government service website**. Documents are not guaranteed to be accepted. Jurisdiction, materials, and acceptance conditions are subject to the latest determination of the local arbitration institution.

## From filling in to submission

1. Select the province, city, district/county, or functional zone. The handling region must be confirmed based on factors such as place of work and the employer's location. Do not select based only on household registration (hukou).
2. Choose an application or an evidence list. The form provides clearly labeled fictitious examples. Replace them with your own information before formal use.
3. Evidence starts with one item and can be added as needed. You can confirm or cancel before generation. After confirmation, download the Word document.
4. Check the local number of copies, the window address, and the handling method. Verified official entry points provide a link. Logins or captchas are completed by the user on the official website themselves.

Reference documents can be generated even if the form is not fully completed, but the missing materials must still be supplemented before submission. Official blank templates, official samples, and platform-assisted documents are labeled separately, so samples are not passed off as blank forms.

## Each region uses its own sources

The system matches items, handling authorities, materials, and attachments to the specific region, retaining official links, collection time, verification status, and the file SHA-256. Switching regions re-queries the data. Where there is no local source, it shows "pending verification" and does not inherit data from neighboring regions.

**Public release data updated 2026-10-28. Nationwide district/county coverage is not yet complete.**

| Scope | Current actual status |
|---|---|
| Provincial entries | 31 provincial-level regions in mainland China. An entry existing does not mean the guide has been verified |
| Region directory | 3,599 district/county or functional-zone source records, covering 3,586 exact region name combinations. This is not a complete national census of functional zones |
| Published local guides | 181 regions: Sichuan 179, Jiangsu 2 |
| Published local fill-in generation | 166 regions: Sichuan 164; Jiangsu Xishan District and Jianhu County, each with its official blank document |
| Guides only, local generation not open | 15 regions |
| Unpublished candidates | 24 regions, none counted in launched coverage |
| Historical provincial documents | Retained as separate entries. Applicable scope must be checked separately. Not counted in district/county completion totals |

Recently added separate materials for Binhai County, Xiangshui County, Shangcheng District of Hangzhou, Binjiang District, and Luyang District of Hefei. Binhai, Xiangshui, and Shangcheng have completed offline fill-in and page-by-page layout checks but still await web acceptance. The Binjiang materials column conflicts with the process, and Luyang's time-limit description has discrepancies. Both are kept as pending verification. Linping search results that landed on municipal-level content have not been used as that district's guide. New candidates are unpublished, and no province is marked as "all districts/counties complete."

After running, view the live matrix at `/admin/regions`. Within the repository, it can be verified…

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

SCPgamerscp/ymm4MCP.body:
# YMM4 MCP Plugin

A plugin that lets Claude operate Yukkuri MovieMaker 4 (YMM4) via MCP.
While watching the video and listening to the audio, the AI automatically generates Yukkuri commentary, explanation, skit, and story videos.

```
[Claude] ←MCP(stdio)→ [Python MCP server] ←HTTP(8765)→ [YMM4 C# plugin] ←internal API→ [YMM4 itself]
```

---

## 🚀 Getting Started (Windows)

1. Download the latest `YMM4McpPlugin-*.ymme` from [Releases](https://github.com/SCPgamerscp/ymm4MCP/releases). Close YMM4, double-click the `.ymme` file, and install it following YMM4's instructions. Users do not need to set `YMM4_PATH` or the .NET SDK.
2. Start YMM4. On a new installation, the plugin's HTTP server starts automatically. You can check the status under "Tools" → "MCP Integration Server". If automatic startup is already disabled, press "▶ Start" on this screen.
3. Fully extract `YMM4McpServer-*.zip` from the same Release, then double-click `mcp-server/install.cmd` (**Python 3.10 or later** is required. If `py -3` points to an older Python, also check for an available `python.exe`). The MCP server is permanently installed to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\YMM4MCP\mcp-server`, so Claude Desktop can launch it even after you delete the extracted ZIP folder. Administrator rights are not required. The installer creates a dedicated virtual environment, installs the dependencies, and automatically adds the `mcpServers.ymm4` setting to the Claude Desktop config. Other existing settings are preserved, and a backup is created when changes are made. In addition to the standard edition's config, if the Microsoft Store edition of Claude Desktop has been initialized, it also configures `%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Packages\\Claude_*\\LocalCache\\Roaming\\Claude\\claude_desktop_config.json` automatically. After installation, restart Claude Desktop. The `.ymme` file does not include the Python server. Release…

# GPT AI Assistant

[Traditional Chinese](https://github.com/SanHsien/gpt-ai-assistant/blob/HEAD/README.md) · [English](https://github.com/SanHsien/gpt-ai-assistant/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) · [Full documentation site](https://sanhsien.github.io/gpt-ai-assistant-docs/) · [Latest Release](https://github.com/SanHsien/gpt-ai-assistant/releases/latest)

**GPT AI Assistant** is a self-hostable **LINE personal AI assistant**. After you deploy it with your own LINE, OpenAI, and Supabase settings, you can chat directly in LINE, send voice messages or images, search for information, manage schedules and tasks, receive reminders, and check the weather.

It is not just another chat interface shell. It is a personal assistant service that uses **LINE as the frontend and a durable queue as the reliability core**: paid AI work and LINE delivery are checkpointed separately, schedules, tasks, and reminders have persistent state, and Google Calendar / Tasks can optionally be integrated.

> **Deployment, environment variables, Google OAuth, operation tutorials, and troubleshooting are authoritative on the [documentation site](https://sanhsien.github.io/gpt-ai-assistant-docs/).** The `docs/` directory in this repo mainly stores the runtime, architecture, data contracts, migrations, technical decisions, and release implementation.

## Who it's for

- Those who want to use their own AI assistant in **LINE** rather than installing another chat app.
- Those who are willing to deploy it themselves and use their own OpenAI / LINE / Supabase credentials and billing.
- Those who need more than chat, including **schedules, tasks, reminders, search, voice, images, and weather**.
- Those who value webhook deduplication, a durable queue, retries, and data boundaries in serverless environments.

The current primary focus of official support is **Traditional Chinese (`zh_TW`) + LINE + OpenAI**. English and Japanese interfaces can be started, but natural-language date parsing, weather formatting, and some intent recognition still use Traditional Chinese as the main acceptance baseline.

## Core capabilities

| Category | What it can do |
| --- | --- |
| AI chat | Continuous chat, continuation, retry, forgetting context; the model can be set via environment variables |
| Voice and images | LINE voice / common audio file transcription, image understanding, GPT Image image generation |
| Search and URLs | SerpAPI search; optional SSRF-safe URL summarization; search results include source links |

# Fish Buddy

A little whale widget on your desktop, plus a DSH plugin. The widget handles listening, seeing, and speaking (voice, companion subtitles, game danmaku, screenshots). The plugin connects it to a chat session you bind it to: what the widget says goes into that session, and the replies from there are sent back to the widget.

This repository contains **both halves**:

| Directory | What it is |
|---|---|
| `app/` | Desktop widget (Python + tkinter, packaged as a single-file exe) |
| `lib/` | DSH plugin (host side + settings page) |
| `tests/` | Tests for the plugin and the program |

> ⚠️ **Two version numbers, don't mix them up**: `app/` is the widget program, `lib/` is the DSH plugin. They increment independently and are not the same number.
> - Current versions: see `app/version.py` and `package.json`. The README intentionally does not hardcode them, so it doesn't need updating on every release.
> - What changed: see `CHANGELOG.md`. Entries are headed 程序 (program) or 插件 (plugin).
> - Downloads: see [Releases](https://github.com/Yuuyuko-uu/dsh-fish-buddy/releases). The exe asset names include the version number.

## What the plugin half does

1. Opens a port on this machine (default `127.0.0.1:8777`) to receive messages sent by the widget;
2. Sends each message **into the chat session you bound** (as if you had said it in that session);
3. When her side finishes a turn, sends the reply **back to the widget** (POST to the callback address you configured);
4. When screenshots or game frames arrive, sends the **image itself** into the session (saved as an attachment first, then referenced);
5. The settings page shows whether the port is reachable, how many messages have arrived, what happened recently, and the last thing she said.

## Asset notes

The character art, speech bubble frames, and danmaku frames in `app/assets/` are distributed with the program and **are not separately licensed for secondary use**. `app/assets/ocr/` contains the PP-OCRv6 detection and recognition models (Apache-2.0). `app/assets/字体/` contains the 站酷快乐体 (ZCOOL KuaiLe) font, which is free for commercial use.

## How to configure after installing

**DSH Settings → Fish Buddy** (first tab):

| Item | What to enter |
|---|---|
| Enabled | On by default. Turning it off means nothing the widget sends is forwarded |
| Send to which session | Pick your session from the dropdown (if none is selected, nothing can be delivered) |
| Local port | Port, default 8777. **Changing the port requires restarting DSH to take effect** |
| Reply callback | The receive address the widget exposes, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8778/hands/reply` |
| Tag the source | When inserting into the session, prefixes the message with （挂件里说的话）, meaning "said in the widget", so you can tell typed input from spoken input |
| **Check for updates** | Click 查一下 ("check"): checks both the **plugin itself** (comparing against the version on the repo's main branch) and the **widget…

# 影刀 xbot AI Agent Development Guide

> A Chinese-language development knowledge base for 影刀 xbot / 编码版, RPA automation, and AI coding agents.

## About This Project

This is a knowledge base I have continuously maintained while developing and maintaining 影刀 automation projects, as part of my personal AI-assisted development workflow. It primarily serves my own projects, and I have made it public in the hope that it will be a useful reference for other developers who use Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar tools to develop 影刀编码版 projects.

This repository is not official 影刀 documentation, and it does not aim to cover every API. Its contents come mainly from real calls, source-code verification, and reproducible issues in personal projects. When developing, use the 影刀 APIs and market instructions according to the official fact pages; if the installed project version lacks an entry described in these docs, check your update status, and report cases where the feature is not yet released or the docs need revision.

This repository addresses “how to develop, maintain, and troubleshoot 影刀 projects,” not “how AI agents should operate a computer or choose host tools.” Host-side plugins, MCP, DevSpace, Computer Use, and tool routing used by ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, and similar hosts to access Windows / macOS, execute code, connect devices, or orchestrate external capabilities are outside this project's scope. Only CLIs, APIs, project formats, and runtime mechanisms directly related to 影刀 itself belong to this knowledge base.

## Why This Knowledge Base Exists

General-purpose code models are usually familiar with Python, Selenium, Playwright, pandas, or openpyxl, but do not inherently know the following about 影刀 projects:

- The real-world usage of xbot objects, element libraries, image libraries, and resource files.
- The API boundaries between browser, Excel / WPS, and Windows automation.
- How market instruction parameters map between the visual interface and the coding edition.
- The relationship between the real 影刀 project directory, `package.json`, and the sync workflow.
- Which conclusions have been verified, and which still need to be confirmed by running them in the current environment.

The goal of this repository is not to make AI “remember more documentation,” but to help it find the correct entry points when uncertain, guess APIs less, and copy outdated experience less.

## What This Repository Contains

### AI Agent Development Rules

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/apexcheng/yingdao-xbot-ai-agent/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): Maintenance rules for the knowledge base itself; the persistent development rules for real projects are in [project-template/AGENTS.md](https://github.com/apexcheng/yingdao-xbot-ai-agent/blob/HEAD/project-template/AGENTS.md).

Download the DMG from [Releases](https://github.com/echoVic/liubai/releases/latest), open it, and drag 留白 into Applications. Requires macOS 13 or later, with support for Apple silicon and Intel. The installer is signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple.

**Traditional Chinese** | [English](https://github.com/juinwei7/Shiyin/blob/HEAD/.github/README.md) | Website: [shiyin.weibuilds.com](https://shiyin.weibuilds.com)

# 拾音 Shiyin

A meeting notes app for macOS. Record a meeting (in person or online), and see a live word-by-word transcript while recording. After recording, transcription and speaker identification run on your machine, and the result is handed to Claude, Codex, or an API to organize into meeting notes. Every note entry carries its recording timestamp; click it to hear the original words.

- Recording, transcription, and speaker identification all happen locally; recordings are not uploaded
- No need to install Python, Homebrew, or ffmpeg; just download the DMG and use it
- The interface is available in Traditional Chinese and English (follows the macOS language); meetings can be in Chinese, English, or Japanese
- Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26

## How to use

1. **Record or import**: Click "Record" (⌘R) in the toolbar. For online meetings, set the recording source to "Microphone + computer audio" so the other party's voice is recorded too. If you already have a recording file, just drag it into the window.
2. **Watch and take notes while recording**: The live transcript is on the left; "My notes" on the right automatically logs the recording time each time you start a new line. For important moments, click "Mark highlight" (⌘B; ⌃⌥⌘B in other apps).
3. **Stop and transcribe**: After you stop, a draft is immediately organized from the live transcript, while formal transcription and speaker separation run locally. Click "Speaker 1" to change it to a name; Shiyin remembers the voice and fills it in automatically next time.
4. **View meeting notes**: After transcription, notes are automatically organized into a summary, decisions, action items, and open questions; each entry can be clicked to jump back to its recording timestamp. Uncertain names and proper nouns become questions to confirm: entries with doubts show a "?" beside them, and clicking one lets you answer on the spot. The "N questions pending confirmation" banner at the top of the notes lets you review them all at once. After you answer, the AI corrects its notes based on your answer (click "Yes" to confirm directly without waiting). To find out who said what, ask directly in the "Ask" tab.
5. **Export or share**: Save meeting notes as Markdown, PDF, or Word, save the transcript as a subtitle file, or package an entire meeting as .shiyin to send to colleagues.

## Features

- **Recording**
  - Source options: "Microphone only", "Microphone + computer audio (online meetings)", or "Computer audio only". The other party's voice in Zoom, Meet, and Teams can also be recorded
  - Shows the live transcript and per-source volume during recording; you can pause, mark highlights, and take notes
  - Capture alerts: when the microphone picks up no sound, the sound is too quiet, or the background is too noisy, the recording screen reminds you; when you're in another app, notifications are sent and the menu bar icon turns into a warning
  - With many people or in noisy settings, you can choose "approximately how many people" during recording or import so speakers are separated more accurately

luo0629/Arclight.body:
# Arclight

**A multi-agent creation project for AI comic-drama and visual storytelling.**

Make story creation a reviewable, traceable, and recoverable production process, rather than a set of independent model calls.

Arclight is aimed at individual creators, small comic-drama studios, and AI content production teams. Its goal is to connect story, script, storyboard, visual assets, and the final cut. Creators handle direction and key decisions, specialized agents handle concrete creative tasks, and the server handles state, versions, review, and execution.

> **Current stage: a usable story-text creation product.**
> The project has implemented a cute-style canvas frontend, accounts and project collaboration, and a two-person manual review workflow for story → script → storyboard. Image, voice-over, and final-cut production are still in development.

## Why Arclight

The difficulty of AI content creation is not just generating a piece of text or an image, but organizing the different stages into a process that can be continuously revised, collaborated on, and delivered:

- **Creative outputs need to become formal artifacts.** Scripts, storyboards, and shot information cannot exist only in chat history. They need to be saved, queried, and linked to specific versions.
- **Key decisions need human confirmation.** Whether a script or storyboard passes should be an explicit review action, not a step the model skips on its own.
- **Interruptions should not lose all progress.** The workflow needs to record its execution position, and support waiting for review, restart recovery, and explicit retry after failure.
- **Extending models should not rewrite business logic.** Generation capabilities are separated from business logic, so the workflow is not bound to any one vendor's SDK.

Arclight will first make the text creation and review pipeline solid, then gradually expand toward a complete comic-drama production workflow.

## What You Can Do Now

### Organize stories on a sticker canvas

The React + TypeScript frontend uses **shadcn/ui (Radix) components and Tailwind CSS v4** throughout, with a story-collage style of paper white, cream, and fluorescent lime, paired with original hand-drawn line illustrations. The product home page provides login and registration dialogs. Project switching, the account menu, member roles, and loading feedback use a unified set of modern interactive components. The left side manages projects and episodes, the center canvas shows episodes, scripts, storyboards, and shots, and the right side reads or edits specific content.

Nodes can be dragged, and layout and viewport are saved to the server. Dependency edges come from real version relationships, so review results cannot be faked by drawing connections by hand. You can also switch to a version list without relying on canvas operations, and small screens keep the list and editing entry points.

After registering and logging in, you can create projects, add episodes, and enter stories. The task center shows status and events, and provides manual review, cancellation, and retry after failure. Project owners can add registered partners and grant them edit or read-only permissions. The settings page supports project configuration and archive restore.

### View the project production overview

The "Project Overview" in the project navigation summarizes all saved text production records across the project, including episode stages, counts of items pending review and confirmed, task status, and recent tasks. The episode directory is paginated independently and can jump directly to the corresponding canvas or to the task and review page. The page supports manual refresh and automatically refreshes every 15 seconds while visible. …

sodahub-org/libmssdk.description: Signing service for the Soda Music app: wraps the official client's bdms.node as an HTTP/stdio service, providing X-Helios / X-Medusa for Linux clients such as libresoda
sodahub-org/libmssdk.body:
# libmssdk

> A local signing service wrapper for the `bdms.node` native signing module in the Soda Music PC client. It exposes the official client's bundled native signing module as HTTP / stdio interfaces, for [libresoda](https://github.com/sodahub-org/libresoda) to call and generate the `X-Helios` / `X-Medusa` request headers.

> **Important**: This repository does not include or redistribute `bdms.node` or `metasecml.dll`. You must copy these two files from your own installed Soda Music client, and only for personal use. This project is not affiliated with ByteDance, Douyin, or Soda Music.

## How it works

```text
libresoda / third-party client
  → POST /sign { url, method, headers, body }
  → libmssdk calls bdms.node
  → returns { X-Helios, X-Medusa }
  → client uses this pair of headers to make the real request
```

The signature covers the URL and all request headers, so the headers passed to `/sign` must be exactly the ones that will actually be sent.

## What credentials are needed for full-track playback

Two things: **the `bdms.node` in your own client**, and **the fact that this song is already fully licensed for you**.

No need for the device ID to match the logged-in device, and no reliance on cookies. Control experiments (same signer, same machine) show that random device IDs, fixed device IDs persisted by the service, and even requests with no cookies at all all return the same six-tier full-track result for the same licensed song. Two preview-only tracks retested with both device ID shapes still returned a single 30–60 second tier. So the deciding factor is the track's licensing layer, not the device identity layer. Combinations not yet tested (whether cookies are present, matching the real logged-in device on *preview-tier* tracks, and which cookie field is missing) are listed in section 7 of the report; those items are the boundaries of this conclusion. For the criteria and reproduction steps, see [`docs/INVESTIGATION-DEVICE-ENTITLEMENT.md`](https://github.com/sodahub-org/libmssdk/blob/HEAD/docs/INVESTIGATION-DEVICE-ENTITLEMENT.md).

This is not a way to 'bypass entitlement': an unlicensed track stays a preview no matter what credentials are used. It only shows that **the app signature itself is the streaming credential**, so a signer open to multiple people effectively puts your exit IP and device profile on the line to bear risk control for everyone. Do not expose it publicly; use a tunnel for cross-machine access.

## Two files you must provide yourself

The official signing module is not in the repository and cannot be redistributed by this repository. Find them in the version directory of **your own installed** Soda Music client and copy them into the same directory:

# libresoda

`libresoda` is a **Rust re-implementation** of the `soda` package from [music-lib](https://github.com/guohuiyuan/music-lib) (Soda Music / 汽水音乐, the official music app of Douyin), packaged as a library crate.

The goal is to give the Rust ecosystem a Soda client that can be used as a direct dependency: search, single tracks / albums / playlists, lyrics, best-quality stream selection for VIP accounts, encrypted audio decryption, my playlists, and the login flow going forward.

tgxy2026/youth-fantasy-engine.body:
# 青春幻想引擎 · Youth Fantasy Engine

**A long-form writing workbench that links worldbuilding, characters, outlines, and manuscript text into one thread**

Desktop (Windows) | Portable (run from a USB drive) | **Web** (use directly in the browser) | Source version `v3.2.2`

📦 Repository: [Gitee](https://gitee.com/tgxy2026/youth-fantasy-engine) | [GitHub](https://github.com/tgxy2026/youth-fantasy-engine) | ⬇️ Download: [Releases](https://gitee.com/tgxy2026/youth-fantasy-engine/releases)

🖥️ Three forms: **Desktop installer** (no Node.js needed, double-click to install) | **Portable** (run from a USB drive, requires Node.js) | **Web** (no installation; guests save locally, paying users get cloud storage for cross-device use)

---

## Foreword (please read this first)

**1. This is a project developed with AI assistance.**

From the first line of code to now, development has relied heavily on AI programming tools. I am laying this out up front rather than hiding it.

**2. Data location and network scope depend on the form and features you use; please check them.**

- Manual writing, material viewing, and local checks in the desktop and portable versions can be used offline. AI features require a local or cloud model service that you configure.
- When using a cloud model, the manuscript and materials used by a given feature are sent to the endpoint you configured. The web cloud mode also saves account materials to the server. Each AI entry point has a data source description.
- Besides model requests, automatic update checks, online search, cloud drive sync, and web account/storage may also use the network. Using a local model does not mean every feature works offline; turn off update checks and other network features as needed.

**3. Regarding the built-in AI features, my position is “assist, not ghostwrite.”**

The software includes a full set of AI capabilities: one-click continuation, whole-chapter rewriting, one-click book breakdown, creative writing, role-play deduction... but the **intent** behind these features is to assist creation: helping you tidy up settings, arrange outlines, and give a nudge where you are stuck, so you can write more smoothly rather than having it write for you.

**I do not recommend using AI to generate novel manuscript text at scale.**

If you just want to play around or try something new, that is fine; the features are there. But if you sincerely want to become a web novel author, **I do not recommend it**. Works should be your own, and there is no shortcut on this path.

---

## What problem it solves

When writing a long work, the real enemy is often not “no inspiration” but **loss of control**. Have you run into any of these?

- You wrote a whole pile of worldbuilding, and at chapter 80 you wanted to check “what the protagonist’s master’s sect is called,” and spent half an hour searching without finding it;
- Characters keep multiplying, and who is related to whom is kept only in your head, so things get tangled as you write;
- You planted a foreshadowing, and 200,000 characters later you have forgotten it entirely, while readers remember it clearly;
- The outline is in document A, the manuscript in document B, and the settings in document C, so changing one place means syncing three;
-…

# Proxy List

## Project Introduction

I found an online proxy webpage that's pretty interesting. Its proxies update quite quickly, so I scraped it. The proxies are basically all usable, not the kind of "10,000 proxies where only a few work" junk.

The website https://tomcat1235.nyc.mn/ has a fairly comprehensive list. If you're interested, go scrape it yourself.

## Features

- ⚡ Automatically scrapes the latest proxy lists
- 🔄 Scheduled updates (runs once every hour)
- 📝 Standard format output: `protocol://ip:port [location]`
- 🌍 Includes geolocation information
- 📊 Supports multiple proxy protocols (HTTP, SOCKS5, etc.)

## Usage

### Manual Run

```bash
python generate_proxy_list.py
```

### Viewing Results

The proxy list is saved in `proxy.txt`, formatted as follows:

```
socks5://37.18.73.60:5566 [United States California San Jose]
http://123.143.162.221:6388 [South Korea Seoul Special City]
socks5://35.183.59.99:5080 [Canada Quebec Province Montreal]

This project uses GitHub Actions for automated updates:

- 🕐 Runs automatically once every hour

- 🔄 Keeps proxy information up to date

## Dependencies

- requests
- beautifulsoup4

This project is intended only for learning and research purposes. Please comply with applicable laws, regulations, and website terms of use.

# Free Node Subscriptions: Usage Guide for Clash, V2RayN, and Shadowrocket

A public subscription directory for Clash, V2RayN, v2rayNG, and Shadowrocket (小火箭). The project maintains only two easily recognizable subscription formats that are simple to import: **Base64 universal subscription** and **Clash YAML subscription**.

> Project homepage: [nodes.udptoos.com](https://nodes.udptoos.com/) · Update frequency: every 2 hours · This repository makes no promises about node speed, stability, or availability in any region.

## Subscription Links

| Format | Compatible clients | Subscription link |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Base64 (universal) | V2RayN, v2rayNG, Shadowrocket / 小火箭, and other clients that support URI subscriptions | `https://nodes.udptoos.com/subscriptions/base64.txt` |
| Clash YAML | Clash Meta, Mihomo, Clash Verge, ClashX, and other YAML configuration clients | `https://nodes.udptoos.com/subscriptions/clash.yaml` |

All entries are displayed in a format like `🇭🇰HK - udptoos.com`: the flag and two-letter country abbreviation identify the exit location, and `udptoos.com` is the unified display name. Entries for the same country may carry a sequence number to avoid name collisions in clients.

## How to Import Subscriptions

### Clash Nodes / Clash Subscriptions

1. Copy the Clash YAML link.
2. Add the URL in the Profiles / 配置订阅 section of Clash Meta, Mihomo, Clash Verge, or ClashX.
3. After downloading or updating the config, select that configuration file.

Clash YAML is a complete configuration format and should not be imported as a Base64 subscription.

### V2RayN Nodes

1. Copy the Base64 universal subscription link.
2. In V2RayN, open the subscription group settings and add the subscription URL.
3. Click update subscription, then select a node from the server list.

### Shadowrocket / 小火箭 Nodes

1. Copy the Base64 universal subscription link.
2. In Shadowrocket, tap the plus icon in the upper right corner and select **Subscribe**.
3. Paste the URL, finish adding it, and update it later from the subscription list.

Menu text may vary slightly between client versions. If import fails, first check that you selected the correct subscription format.

## Node Naming and GEO Information

Node names are generated with a country abbreviation and flag based on the public geolocation attribution of the exit IP. For example, `🇭🇰HK - udptoos.com` means the node resolves to an IP…
